'''''Choices of One''''' is a [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] novel by author [[Timothy Zahn]] that serves as a sequel to Zahn's [[2007]] novel, [[Allegiance (novel)|''Allegiance'']]. It was first published by [[Del Rey]] in hardcover on [[July 19]], [[2011]]. The first paperback edition was released on [[June 26]], [[2012]].
